title: The 4 Best Packing Cubes for Backpacking
h1: The 4 Best Packing Cubes for Backpacking
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for packing cubes for backpacking, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at packing cubes for backpacking using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Eagle Creek Pack-It Specter Cube Set (S/M)
products.blurb: Key specs: Set of 2 cubes: small and medium, 70D recycled ripstop nylon shell, Combined weight under 9 ounces.
strengths: Ripstop fabric resists tearing under a backpack's external compression straps better than standard nylon
Adds almost no weight to a pack already loaded with a tent, sleeping bag, or electronics
Survives years of daily hostel-to-hostel handling in long-term owner reports
limitations: No compression zipper, so a fixed-volume pack still needs careful folding
Only 2 sizes, most backpackers need a second set for a longer trip
features: Set of 2 cubes: small and medium

products.name: Gonex Compression Packing Cubes 10 Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Double zipper compression on every cube, Honeycomb ripstop fabric, See-through mesh panels.
strengths: Compression zippers reclaim real volume in a pack that cannot expand like a suitcase
Dedicated shoe and laundry bags keep dirty gear separate in shared hostel rooms
Lowest cost per piece of any set here, useful on a backpacker's budget
limitations: Thinner fabric than Eagle Creek, needs more careful handling under heavy external compression
Compression zippers are the most likely failure point after months of daily use
10 loose pieces is more to keep track of when packing quickly to catch transport
features: Double zipper compression on every cube

products.name: TravelWise Packing Cube System 5 Piece Weekender Plus Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 cubes: 1 small, 2 medium, 2 large, Mesh top panel, 2-way pull zippers.
strengths: 2 medium plus 2 large sizes match a typical multi-week backpack's clothing volume
Nests flat for the rare hostel with limited room storage
limitations: No compression zipper for a fixed-volume pack
Fabric and zippers show wear faster under daily backpack compression than ripstop options
Fewer color choices in stock, less useful for quickly identifying gear by color

products.name: eBags Classic 4 Piece Packing Cube Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 4 cubes: large, medium, small, and slim, TechLite diamond nylon, YKK zippers.
strengths: Lifetime warranty is useful protection for gear that gets months of continuous hard use
Slim cube fits a packable rain layer or a stack of travel documents
YKK zippers hold up better than budget zippers over an extended multi-month trip
limitations: No compression zipper for a fixed-volume backpack
Heavier than the Eagle Creek set for a similar piece count
Costs more upfront than budget-oriented sets
features: 4 cubes: large, medium, small, and slim

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
